seo.title: Michelle Hernandez, LISW, LCSW, MSW — Executive Clinical Director | Des Moines Wellness Center
seo.description: Meet Michelle Hernandez, LISW, LCSW, MSW, Executive Clinical Director at Des Moines Wellness Center, with nearly a decade of experience in mental health, substance use and co-occurring care.

image.alt: Michelle Hernandez, LISW, LCSW, MSW - Executive Clinical Director

sections.heading: About:
body: Michelle Hernandez is a Licensed Independent Social Worker who is passionate about helping individuals feel heard, supported, and empowered throughout their mental health and recovery journeys. As Executive Clinical Director, she is committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive treatment environment where individuals can work toward healing, build confidence, and develop the skills needed for lasting change.

Michelle brings nearly a decade of experience in behavioral health, having worked in residential treatment centers, hospitals, and outpatient settings. Her background includes supporting children, adolescents, and adults experiencing a wide range of mental health concerns, substance use challenges, eating disorders, trauma, and co-occurring conditions. Throughout her career, she has provided individual, group, and family therapy, crisis intervention, and individualized treatment planning, helping people navigate difficult experiences and work toward meaningful, lasting change.

Michelle earned her Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and Master of Social Work, with a concentration in Adult Mental Health and Wellness, from the University of Southern California. Her approach to care is rooted in compassion, collaboration, and the belief that every person’s experiences and needs are unique. She values meeting people where they are, building genuine connections, and helping individuals recognize their strengths as they navigate challenges.

In her role as Executive Clinical Director, Michelle looks forward to supporting both patients and the clinical team while fostering an environment where quality care, teamwork, and personal growth remain priorities. She believes recovery is not always a straight path and that everyone deserves to feel respected, understood, and supported along the way.

sections.heading: Ready to Take the First Step?
body: Recovery is built on relationships. If you’re looking for help with addiction or mental health challenges, our team is here to guide you every step of the way. Contact Des Moines Wellness Center to learn more about our programs and admissions process.

sections.heading: Recovery Starts With the Right People
body: At Des Moines Wellness Center, our team is committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based care for addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions. Whether you’re looking for medical detox, residential treatment, IOP, or ongoing recovery support, we’re here to help you find the right path forward. Contact our admissions team today to learn more about treatment options, verify insurance, and take the first step toward lasting recovery.
